resources.string: The server cannot be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
The server answered with an error (%1$d).
1. Open the invitation email from the organizer on this phone.
2. Tap the link in it; this app opens and shows your race.
3. Agree to the tracking and tap “Start tracking” before your start.
If the link opens in the browser instead, copy it and paste it here:
This is not a valid invitation link.
On an iPhone use the OwnTracks app as described on the invitation page.
We have sent a new link to your email address.
This event has already finished; nothing to track.
This phone is set up for “%1$s”. Continuing replaces that setup.
Your phone has already been set up (for example in OwnTracks). After you continue, the previous setup stops working; tracking runs in this app.
The organizer sees your position exactly and immediately.
Spectators see it delayed, and only during the race.
Positions are kept for 30 days after the event, then deleted. You can ask the organizer to delete them at any time.
The app sends your position only while tracking is on, and switches itself off when the race is over.
I agree to share my location during the race.
Spectators may see my name (otherwise only my bib).
Switch it on before your start, best when you arrive at the start area. Until 10 minutes before the start the phone saves battery.
Tracking switches itself off when the organizer finishes the race.
The organizer and the spectators will no longer see where you are. Stop only if you have finished or left the race.
Remove this race from the phone
The app forgets this race and stops tracking. To track again you need the invitation link.
In an emergency call the organizer or 112. This app helps the organizer, it is not a safety system. Keep the phone charged and do not switch on battery saver during the race.
Xiaomi: also Settings → Apps → PositionTracker → Autostart on, Battery saver → No restrictions.
Huawei/Honor: also Settings → Battery → App launch → PositionTracker → Manage manually, all switches on.
Samsung: also Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: PositionTracker must not be in “Sleeping apps”.
Also allow background activity / auto launch for PositionTracker in the battery settings.
Tracking is on; the organizer has not started the event yet
Tracking was interrupted – start it again
Tracking switched itself off 12 hours after your start
The organizer has not started the event yet; positions are accepted once it is live.
Before the start: one position every %1$d s to save battery.
The server does not know you in this event any more. Ask the organizer.
The organizer receives your position with problems
The organizer has not received your position for a while
The organizer has not received any position yet
The phone clock is wrong; switch on automatic date and time.
The position is inaccurate; go outside under the open sky.
The battery is low; charge the phone.
Some positions were refused by the server.
Test before the start is OK: positions arrive, they are recorded from the start.
“%1$s” has finished. Tracking is off and the race data were deleted from this phone. Thank you!
This phone is no longer set up for the race: it was set up again on another phone, or the organizer removed it. Open the invitation link again if you want to track with this phone.
Waiting for the organizer to start the event
The race is over, tracking is off
“%1$s” has finished. PositionTracker no longer uses your location.
This phone is no longer set up for the race.
